title: She Called 911 on Herself and Instantly Regretted It
description:
Bodycam footage shows  New Mexico police arresting a 44-year-old woman after she called 911 on herself in July. Bernalillo authorities said Desiree Sanchez was one of three inmates who were mistakenly released from jail. Police caught up with Sanchez after she called the police to “turn herself in,” yet she appeared to regret her decision when they confronted her. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
